title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E6 — We Were Robbed
Fred covers his clumsiness by proclaiming 'we were robbed' and he turns into a boastful hero cited for bravery. But Lamont finds the shattered remains of his prized porcelain and glass collection and decides to teach his father a lesson.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E7 — A Pad For Lamont
Angered by his father's constant interruption of his dates, Lamont moves out to pursue the life of a swinging bachelor. But much to Lamont's disappointment, it's the newly unchaperoned Fred who is besieged by the ladies.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E22 — Uncle George And Aunt Louise
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E23 — George And Louise In A Bind
A burglar ties up George and Louise and gives them a night to remember in a special 90-minute episode. As they wait to be rescued, George and Louise re-live (by flashback) some of their most unforgettable and hilarious experiences.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E26 — Jenny's Thesis
Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E1 — Louise's Painting
George riled by bare facts.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E4 — How Slowly They Forget
George's unexpected offer to help Louise and Allan cut through the red tape that's delaying the move of the Help Center turns into more trouble than anyone is prepared to handle.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E20 — The Amazing Kreskin, Diana Sands, Dom DeLuise
Kreskin performs magic and acts in a sketch w/Flip & Diana Sands; Dom DeLuise battles Geraldine in the grocery store.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E21 — Della Reese, George Carlin, Roy Clark
Carlin & Flip report the news; Carlin does a monologue on race & society and the cast does a comic courtroom scene.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E22 — Rich Little, Ed McMahon, Cicely Tyson
Cast does a Tonight Show spoof with Rich as Johnny Carson; Flip & Cicely’s honeymoon gets disrupted by dentists.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E23 — Tim Conway, Joe Namath
Legendary New York Jets quarterback Joe Namath holds his own with sketch comedy pros Tim & Flip incl. a Geraldine bit.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E1 — Muhammad Ali
Former heavyweight boxing champion Muhammad Ali is interviewed.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E2 — Mandrill/LaBelle
Mrs. Georgia Jackson, mother of slain Soledad Brother George Jackson, is interviewed by producer- Ellis Haizlip.  Other show features include the exciting Latin-jazz sounds of  seven man combo.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E13 — What Price Friendship?
Webster tries to buy friendship to fit in with the two coolest kids in his school, Joey and David. George finds out he's supposed to speak at a ceremony for Gloria Steinem.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E1 — San Francisco: Part 1
Webster, Katherine and George help a musician (played by Lee Weaver) make his way to San Francisco to play with his old band at their 40th reunion show.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E2 — Katherine, the Greek
When George is a flop at predicting football games, he enlists the aid of Katherine, who proves to have an uncanny knack for picking winners.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E3 — Hello, Nicky
Webster helps his cousin Nicky, who's afraid to tell his family that he doesn't want to move to Nigeria with them.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E4 — Breaking Away
An enthusiastic George takes the family on a fishing trip, but all Webster can think about is the fun he could be having with his buddies.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E7 — Halloween
While the twins go in search of a Halloween rave, Lisa and Ray attend a fancy party thrown by a prospective client.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E8 — Weird Science
Tia and Tamera think they're in for a "free ride" when Ray starts dating their science teacher.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E9 — Thanksgiving in Hawaii (Part I)
When Ray and Lisa take the girls to Hawaii for Thanksgiving, they're forced to share their condo with their "exes," who have begun dating each other.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E10 — Thanksgiving in Hawaii (Part II)
While Ray and Lisa frantically search for the twins, who are missing in Hawaii, Roger opens the Campbell/Landry home to hobos for Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E11 — Private School
The prospect of Tia's attending a prestigious prep school puts social pressure on Tia and financial pressure on Lisa.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E4 — Mis-Directed Study
Moesha is flying high after she gets a job tutoring one of the basketball team’s star players until she finds out what kind of game he really wants to play.
